provenance.cases: Frozen S59 PTX, not an S60 refinement; representative measured win and loss; diagnostics never admit timing.

limits: Only exact Mapal driver-PTX images; no cuBLAS/CUTLASS executed-image claim.
SASS/PTX counts are static instructions in the captured function, not dynamic instruction count, DRAM traffic, achieved occupancy or timing cause.
Instrumented completion/value gates are diagnostic; ordinary timings must come from separate uninstrumented processes.
First missing/failed observer boundary is an explicit non-admission, not inferred success.
